name: KOF98-JpnStreetStage.png
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: actual horizontal scrolling background for a Super Nintendo / PC Engine 16-bit fighting game, inspired by the visual clarity of Street Fighter II.
Primary request: REDRAW the supplied KOF98 stage as beautiful economical pixel art, not a blurry reduction. Reference is for scene identity and composition.
Output: one full-bleed very wide panorama, aspect 16:7, intended final native size exactly 512x224 pixels. No panels, margins or captions.
Style: deliberate crisp pixel clusters, clean stepped contours, expressive silhouettes, strong broad light/shadow shapes, restrained 15-color total palette. Use flat colors and repeated modular 8x8 pixel tile motifs for floor, walls, roof, railings. Broad quiet areas and repeated details reduce unique tile count; target <=512 unique 8x8 tiles at native size. Avoid noise, dithering, tiny unique texture, smooth gradients, blur, antialiasing, realistic rendering.
Composition: preserve recognizable landmark positions and horizon of reference, full panorama. Keep bottom quarter an uninterrupted horizontal fighting floor, no fighters or HUD. Background detail must read behind sprites. Maintain original setting and lighting with richer harmonious contrast.

Scene: Japanese city street beneath dark red steel railway girders. Background traffic includes an ochre small car, pale trucks and teal van; distant bright street opening and small spectator silhouettes at right. Render cars as legible simple pixel silhouettes, structure girders as repeated tiles, pavement as large muted warm gray shapes with clear white crossing stripes. Dark plum shadows, teal accents, warm gold highlights. Reference image 1 is the detailed original.
